settings.title: Work is over, but I am still in it
settings.body: Your body has left the desk, but your attention has not.

settings.title: I have no drive left
settings.body: Starting even ordinary things feels much harder than it used to.

settings.title: Weekends do not restore me
settings.body: Time away happens, but recovery never seems to arrive.

settings.title: Rest itself feels impossible
settings.body: Stopping creates agitation, guilt, or an immediate need to fill the space.

settings.heading: When rest is no longer giving anything back.
settings.body: Being unable to switch off, losing drive, and never feeling restored can overlap without being identical. Begin with the experience that is most present now.
settings.primary_label: Find someone who works with this
settings.note: After Work is a practical tool, not treatment. Persistent exhaustion, major changes in mood, or safety concerns deserve qualified care.
